text:
QUOTE: "unless the repo declares an `index_scope:` in its `.clew.yaml`, clew indexes the whole repository" and "nothing declared (the default) ── whole_repo_scope(repo)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says a declared `index_scope` wins and that the absence of one falls through to the whole repository. It adds that the CLI refuses an unusable declaration, but that is a separate case from failing to find one.
